book.totem.locksmith_manual.title: Locksmith Method Guide
book.totem.locksmith_manual.page.1:
PADLOCKS

Use one Padlock on a Chest, Trapped Chest, or Barrel. A double chest and every container connected by fixed Hopper routes share that one lock.
book.totem.locksmith_manual.page.2:
THE ROOT

The first container is the root. Breaking a middle Hopper splits the graph: only the root side stays locked; the detached side unlocks without copying the Padlock.
book.totem.locksmith_manual.page.3:
ACCESS

Owners can set private, allowlist, friends, or public access and deny, trusted, or all automation. A Blocked member overrides keys and public access.
book.totem.locksmith_manual.page.4:
BREAKS & KEYS

Players may break locked members under normal rules. Non-owner breaks send a DiscordBridge audit event. Use /locksmith while looking at the network to issue or revoke keys.
